unverified: exploding 6s: the extra dice can hit, but they are not counted as 1s and not counted in the pool when checking for a glitch
wound penalty: only complete rows of 3 boxes count, so a short last row adds nothing
a threshold of 0 is treated as 1, since the book defines thresholds from 1 and a roll with no hits should not succeed
an attack whose attacker rolls no hits misses even when the defender also rolls none; the book says ties go to the aggressor and the most hits wins, but does not say whether 0 against 0 hits
a bought automatic hit counts as a hit when deciding whether a glitch is critical
+1 to a single die cannot be used on a 6
Edge given to an ally counts toward the ally's per-round gain cap and the overall maximum
the healing threshold is 5 minus Essence rounded up, never below 0, so a fully natural patient (Essence 6) has threshold 0
the free hit for a fully natural patient applies to first aid and medkits, where the book states it, and not to healing magic
an attempt at first aid, a medkit or healing magic uses up that treatment for the set of injuries even if it heals nothing
a new set of injuries begins when the character next takes damage, after which each treatment can be received again
first aid, a medkit and healing magic heal no physical or stun box while any overflow box is filled; natural recovery is rolled for each track separately and is not held up by overflow
natural recovery of stun and physical damage takes no wound penalty, since the book subtracts wound modifiers only for overflow, and an unconscious character can roll it
the book's time limits (a minute for first aid, an hour for a medkit, an hour or a day between natural recovery rolls) and medkit supplies are the GM's to keep; the system tracks no game time
natural recovery can be rolled only by a player character for their own injuries
outside a fight there are no rounds, so a player has one expenditure of Edge per roll
Edge is gained only while a confrontation is under way, and the system counts a confrontation as a fight started with start_combat, which the GM uses for hacks and social contests too
Edge gained by an opponent's side of a rating gap is dropped, because non-player characters do not use Edge
a GM award is 1 Edge a time with a reason, counts toward the same limit of two gained a round, and goes only to a player character who is still active
the Attack Rating and Defense Rating are the GM's numbers, worked out from gear, since a sheet's gear is free text
Edge can be given to an ally only in a confrontation, since that is the only time Edge is gained, and the ally must be on their feet and able to gain it
healing a box with Edge works for an unconscious character, who has a second wind, but not a dead one; it is not a treatment, so overflow does not have to be healed first
Edge added to initiative takes effect when the next round begins, which is where the book's 'next Initiative Cycle' lands in this game
a special effect is the GM's to decide: the system charges the Edge and tells the GM, who is asked to make something happen that helps without winning the scene
outside a fight each standalone use of Edge is its own round, so it does not stop the next roll's expenditure
a gaming session, for Edge, is one sitting: every player character's Edge points start at their Edge attribute whenever the server starts
a player decides on Edge after seeing their dice only by asking to hold the roll when they answer it; a roll that is not held counts at once
dice rerolled with Edge, and the extra dice for exploding 6s, may be rolled by hand and reported on the same trust as the first roll, or rolled by the app
the boost that adds 1 to a die raises only the player's own dice, each at most once, while a reroll may name an opponent's dice, which the player rolls or has the app roll
Edge may be spent on a roll to resist damage and on either side of an attack, but not yet on initiative, on other characters, or on the book's Edge Actions
the book says initiative scores change for injury and special effects but gives no number, so wounds do not change anyone's score
a character who joins a fight already under way rolls initiative and takes their place by score, without moving anyone already in the order
the book leaves a grunt's Composure threshold to the GM; the system uses a fixed threshold of 2 and tests once, when the grunt first passes their Professional Rating while still standing
a grunt that fails Composure bolts, which the GM is told to carry out; one that passes holds for the rest of the fight
a grunt knocked out by stun damage who is then hit by physical damage is dead, since the last damage decides
damage past a grunt's last box is not tracked; a grunt hit by physical damage last is treated as dead
grunts cannot be healed, since the book gives no healing for a single combined track
a group attack takes the named attacker's wounds off their pool before adding the group's bonus dice, and the Attack Rating bonus for extra members waits for Edge
